d83vusnvdm.text: Push a dowel (C) into each edge of the end panels. Fit the left end panel (6) and an end rail (14) between legs 9 and 11, the right ones between legs 10 and 12, and turn the cam locks (B): two at each end of a panel, one at each end of a rail.

e3x97t0fnh.text: Turn four cam bolts (D) into the top (1) and push two dowels (A) into the top edge of each side. Press the top on and lock it with four cam locks (E) in the sides.

ems4dox234.text: Fix the sides to the right drawer front.

fpmgi0anut.text: Push it against the wall and mark through the straps, then drill, push in the wall plugs (K) and screw each strap to the wall with a long screw (F) and a washer (M). Check the wall for pipes and cables first.

gawsvz7jrm.text: Rest each drawer's runners on the ones in the table and push it home until it clicks over the stops.

i0w5860hy4.text: Stand the cabinet up. Lay both doors (8) face down on a rug and press a hinge (I) into each cup hole, two small screws (H) each.

ikaolxxqly.text: Lay the top (1) face down. Two dowels (C) and two screws (D) fix the rail (9) along its front edge, four cam bolts (A) go in over the side panels and the two wall brackets (M) at the back edge, one screw (L) each. Turn two cam bolts (A) into each leg (5 to 8).

juupipka1i.text: Push it against the wall and mark through the two wall brackets, then drill, push in the wall plugs (M) and drive a screw (D) through each bracket and the back into its plug. Check the wall for pipes and cables first.

jywi3l7laz.text: Push twelve dowels (c) in and join the four dividers (7) to the shelves as the manual lays them out: divider, shelf (5), divider, middle shelf (6), divider, shelf (5), divider. In the finished bookshelf they sit right, left, right, left from the top.

k3stz9i6mg.text: You'll need six wooden dowels and two cam locks.

kjietp4qxb.text: Four cam bolts (D) into the back of each front (8). Push the box onto them and turn four cam locks (E) in its sides, then screw the left runner (M) and the right runner (L) along the bottom of its sides, three small screws (N) each.

kjlq4n09zl.text: Push eight dowels (c) into the top edges of the frame rails (9) and ends (10), set them on the bottom and drive the long screws (f) through them into it.

mdsgy0u20e.text: Two screws (D) through each side into the back (19). Then the left runner (DL) along the bottom of the left side and the right runner (DR) on the right side, three small screws (F) each.

ns0k0rfuwf.text: You'll need the nails and the nails.

ovl5z4eilt.text: Screw the two wall brackets (i) to the top at the back, one small screw each.

q77tqwxeis.text: Stand the shelf and the rail on the right side.

rdbzs1qcuy.text: Hold each door between the front legs and screw its hinge plates to the post behind the leg, four screws (G) each: the left door (11) on the left, the right door (12) on the right.

rg5qwz5hjz.text: Turn it on its side. Push two dowels (A) into the bottom edge of each side, lay the bottom (4) on and drive four screws (B) through it with the small hex key (H).

teskjb18cb.text: Press the top onto the dowels at the open end and lock its bolts with four cam locks (C) in the sides. Then drive three long screws (F) up through the rail into the top.

w0m15fwuil.text: A left cabinet runner (CL) on the block of the left end panel (6) and a right one (CR) on the right end panel (7), with two cam bolts (A) in each panel under its block. On the divider (8), a right runner (CR) on one face, then turn it over for a left runner (CL) on the other. Three small screws (F) each.

w7ofcl2sxi.text: You'll need twelve wooden dowels, twelve cam bolts and twelve cam locks.

x9a0azqv9v.text: Fix the sides to the left drawer front.

xhvio0aqi3.text: You'll need four wooden dowels, two cam locks, two Allen bolts and two barrel nuts.

xxr6mxof3.text: An angle bracket (K) in the corner at each leg, under the bottom, two screws (L) each: one into the leg, one up into the panel above it. Stick a felt pad (O) under each leg.

xzi5o71bkm.text: Lay it on its front. Smooth side in, slide the back (5) along the grooves from the open bottom end until it reaches the top.
